description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Layout_Horizontal', which manages a horizontal layout for displaying two elements side by side in a graph rendering utility. It includes methods for layout splitting, size calculation, and rendering output.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Layout_Horizontal
classes.description: A class for managing horizontal side-by-side layout of two graph elements, with adjustable split percentage or absolute position.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Layout_Horizontal
methods.description: Constructor for the horizontal layout, initializing with two parts and a split percentage.

methods.name: _getAbsolute
methods.description: Calculates the absolute pixel position of the split for a given part.

methods.name: _split
methods.description: Splits the layout between the two parts based on the specified percentage.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Outputs the layout to the canvas, ensuring both parts are rendered.
